notes: Starting (8) as posted: Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi, Executor: Meditation Chamber, Executor: Holotheatre, Visage Of The Emperor, Prepared Defenses, Imperial Arrest Order & Secret Plans, Crush The Rebellion, You Cannot Hide Forever & Mobilization Points; all count toward the 60. Total 60.

Posted 'Hunt Down and Smack the Jedi' dested Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe; 'Visage of the Big Ugly Head' (starting) and 'Visage x3' (Effects) dested Visage Of The Emperor (destiny 7; the strategy says 'Why 3 Visages? ... 7's are pretty'), four copies in all, kept as published although unique.
Posted 'Preped D' dested Prepared Defenses; 'No Hide Forever/Mob Pts' dested You Cannot Hide Forever & Mobilization Points.

Posted 'DDB' dested Death Star: Docking Bay 327 (Dark); the strategy calls the docking bays 'The CC/D* DBS'. 'CCDB' dested Cloud City: East Platform (Docking Bay), the Dark Cloud City docking bay. A strategy update says Endor DB was added as a third battleground, but the list still shows only these three locations; kept as listed.

Posted 'Vader, DLOTS' dested Darth Vader, Dark Lord Of The Sith (x2 kept as published although unique); 'King Palpy' dested Emperor Palpatine (x2 likewise); 'Janus the GOD' Janus Greejatus; '4-Lom w/ long stick' 4-LOM With Concussion Rifle; 'Ig w/gun' IG-88 With Riot Gun; 'Mara, The Emperors Ho' Mara Jade, The Emperor's Hand.

'Flying Blue Things (4)' is the starship section header: 'Bobby in Slave 1' dested Boba Fett In Slave I, 'Zucky in da Hunter' Zuckuss In Mist Hunter, 'Maul's Sith thing' Maul's Sith Infiltrator, 'Bossk in Tooth' Bossk In Hound's Tooth.
Posted 'Short Range Ships/ Watch Your Back' dested Short Range Fighters & Watch Your Back! (strategy: it pulls Maul's ship); 'Twi'lek' dested Twi'lek Advisor; 'Holonet Trans' HoloNet Transmission.

Posted 'Allegations of Corruption' and 'DO They Have a Code Clearance' are in the Effects section, so they dested the Coruscant Effects. 'Maul's Saber' dested Maul's Lightsaber (Tatooine), for Darth Maul.
Near-identical to the same player's later 'Homemade Huntdown Ver NO R3' (DeckTech 19669).
